comparison.objective: Remove a service plug, then two battery busbars; candidate extracts one reusable harness terminal from a connector.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequenced grasping and hazard-clear transport versus fine extraction-tool insertion, internal-lance release, and low-force withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Plug out first; bars safely in tray versus correct terminal removed with housing, terminal, and neighbors undamaged. Candidate lacks part-specific inspection limits.
comparison.reason: Electrical disassembly order and busbar clearance do not test connector retention-feature release or reusable terminal extraction.
